label: early copy steps (outputs 2-3) of length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at the first two copy steps after the delimiter step (recall_idx 1 and 2, i.e. t = L+1, L+2) of the longest sequences (L=9 carries 95% of mass, L=8 about 5%, never L<=7). Strongest at recall_idx 1 (input = first original token, ~72% of mass) and weaker at recall_idx 2. Never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or later in the copy. Within that window it fires on only ~35% of steps; firing and magnitude depend on token identity (inputs/outputs u, j, i, g, o, digits favored), but no simple token set improved F1, so the token dependence is left unexplained. Top activations are the recall_idx-1 step of L=9 sequences beginning with u/j/i/s.
